name: Otto no Inu Ma ni... ~Watashi Odosarete, Anata ni Ienai Koto Shimashita~
original_name: 夫の居ぬ間に… ～わたし脅されて、あなたに言えないコトしました～
source:
Kimijima Yayoi is a housewife who has been married for just three years.
Although she feels lonely since her husband Kouhei works in the finance industry and leaves home frequently, she stills spends every day happily with newly-wed feelings.

One day, Kouhei's little sister, Asahi approached her for consultation.
Asahi caused an accident and asked for her help since she had to pay large amount of money as compensation.

While surprised, since she was the sister of her beloved husband and thinking that she was relying on her, Yayoi sincerely tried responding.
However, Yayoi who tried to settle the matter of her sister-in law's consultation peacefully, was caught in a cunning trap laid by men.

While stalked, her weakness was grasped and they demanded her body instead of money...
What will end up happening in the future Yayoi chose...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=967834]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
君岛弥生是一位结婚才三年的家庭主妇。
虽然因为丈夫耕平在金融行业工作、经常离家而感到孤独，但她仍然怀着新婚的心情快乐地度过每一天。

有一天，耕平的妹妹朝日向她寻求咨询。
朝日发生了事故，需要支付大笔赔偿金，请求她的帮助。

弥生虽然惊讶，但因为她是心爱丈夫的妹妹，认为自己是依赖自己的，所以也真诚地尝试着回应。
然而，试图和平解决嫂子协商问题的弥生，却落入了男人们设下的狡猾陷阱。

在跟踪过程中，他们抓住了她的弱点，他们索要的是她的身体而不是金钱……
弥生选择的未来会发生什么……

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=967834]Getchu[/url]]
